item.title: Supermail 0.2.793
item.description:
• Settings from Gmail move into the encrypted database, the log names no one, Help → Privacy Policy
  • Settings in the side menu, above Send Feedback (Mac + iPhone)
  • The Settings card can't be read backwards
  • Read statuses (staff app): "Seen 5m ago" by the emails you send, with its own Supabase server
  • A sync cut off when the iPhone app was put to sleep tries again right away
  • A gray accent no longer makes buttons look switched off (Mac + iPhone)
  • Text selection color in Settings → Colors: the highlight on selected text in emails, the reply box and fields (Mac + iPhone)
  • Staff app counts how often each feature is used and sends the counts to Supermail Admin (counts only)
  • Pull to refresh's spinner goes away within 10 seconds (it could spin for good)
  • Mail you sent from an alias says "me", like Gmail (conversation, inbox, side panel; Mac + iPhone)
  • The release log says 1 person, and the Undo Send note says the wait follows you (#171)
  • Undo Send's wait follows you to your other devices
  • An email with screenshots after every update, Cmd+K → What's New, and notes for the last week
  • Advanced Search: Gmail's search options form (Mac), staff Create filter
  • Each test run keeps its settings to itself, so two chats testing at once can't leave Smart Compose off
  • Did you forget an attachment? Ask before sending when the draft says "attached" and nothing is (Mac + iPhone)
  • Settings → Gmail → Signature: edit your Gmail signature (staff), see it with Edit in Gmail (public)
  • Vacation responder: set Gmail's from Settings, with a quiet top bar reminder and Turn off (Mac)
  • Send from Gmail aliases, pick From with ⌘⇧F, reply from the address mail came to
  • Undo Send: choose 5, 10, 20 or 30 seconds in Settings → Writing (Mac + iPhone)
  • Settings on all your devices through iCloud: colors, swipes, ! and every other choice (Mac + iPhone)
  • Staff app reports its version and crashes to Krinkov's Supermail Admin (never email)
  • A picture that can't load shows nothing, not an empty box with a ? (CDTFA reminder)
  • Settings → Colors: background themes, separate colors, account and Super Label colors (Mac + iPhone)
  • New Super Label: make the label, label the mail that matches, add the Super Label, in one box
  • Send Feedback in the staff app makes a Krinkov task for Luke (email if Krinkov can't take it)
  • Long replies grow with the draft: no 460 pt reply box, the conversation page scrolls
  • From: and the words have to match the same email
  • Settings → Shortcuts: ! can mark spam and block the sender (staff)
  • Has:attachment holds for the email that matches, not the whole conversation
